settings.hero_subtitle: Exclusive access, dedicated support and considered pieces for residential and commercial projects.
settings.intro_heading: A trade programme for considered interiors
settings.intro_body: Whether you are an interior designer, architect, hotelier, stylist or property developer, William Wood Trade gives you access to preferential pricing, dedicated support and a refined collection of mirrors, furniture and homeware.
settings.split1_heading: Pieces selected with your projects in mind
settings.split1_body: From statement mirrors to furniture and accessories, our range is curated to support complete schemes and styling moments across homes, hospitality spaces and commercial projects.
settings.split2_heading: A dedicated team from brief to delivery
settings.split2_body: Our trade team can help with product guidance, availability, lead times and order support, so you can keep each project moving with clarity.
settings.steps_body: Complete the application form and our trade team will review your details before getting in touch.
settings.form_body: Tell us a little about your business and the projects you work on. Our team will respond as soon as possible.

settings.title: Submit your details
settings.body: Complete the trade application form with your business and project information.

settings.title: Application review
settings.body: Our trade team will review your application and contact you with the next steps.

settings.title: Start sourcing
settings.body: Once approved, you can begin using your trade account for eligible William Wood pieces.

settings.question: Who can apply for a trade account?
settings.answer: Our trade programme is open to interior designers, architects, stylists, hoteliers, property developers and other trade professionals.

settings.question: How long does approval take?
settings.answer: The William Wood Trade team will respond as soon as possible after receiving your application.

settings.question: Can I use trade support for a project order?
settings.answer: Yes. Our team can help with product information, availability and order support for eligible projects.
